summary: VinFast Auto Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a leadership transition effective September 12, 2026: the Board appointed Mr. Pham Nhat Quan Anh, currently Chairman, as Chief Executive Officer, succeeding founder Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong, who remains a director. Mr. Anh also becomes Chairman and CEO of VinFast Vietnam JSC. No price, stake, premium or advisor terms were disclosed; the filing cites fresh perspectives and operational excellence. The transition is internal and family-linked within the Vingroup ecosystem. Watch for strategic-direction signals, potential governance scrutiny and any follow-on capital or restructuring actions under new management.
